title: CS 285
description: # Deep Reinforcement Learning. Lectures: Mon/Wed 10-11:30 a.m., Soda Hall, Room 306. The course is **not** being offered as an online course, and the videos are provided only for your personal informational and entertainment purposes. **Looking for deep RL course materials from past years?**. Office Hours: Wed 11.30-12.30pm, Soda 347 alcove. Office Hours: Thurs 9-10am, Soda 347 alcove. Office Hours: Fri 10-11am, Soda 347 alcove. ## Course Introduction, Imitation Learning. * Lecture 1: Introduction and Course Overview. ## Imitation Learning. * Lecture 4: Introduction to Reinforcement Learning. ## Policy Gradients and Actor Critic. ## Value Functions and Q-learning. * Lecture 8: Deep RL with Q-functions. ## Advanced Policy Gradients and Model-based learning. Monday, September 30 - Friday, October 4. ## Advanced Model Learning and Imitating Optimal Controllers. * Lecture 11: Model-based Reinforcement Learning. * Homework 4: Model-based RL. * Lecture 12: Model-based Policy Learning. ## Inverse Reinforcement Learning and multi-task learning. Monday, October 28 - Friday, November 1.
